  <div class="ws-instruction">
    For each metric, record its Month 0 baseline, the named system of record, and the person who owns the number. Enter your current figure, dated target and trend with its prior value. Grade every row, name the grade's source, and write the specific observation that would falsify the target. Add the pre-agreed tripwire action and watcher. Before launch, treat every missing baseline or system of record as instrumentation to establish on day one. Complete the decision asks for this quarter. Do not issue a target without its evidence grade and falsifier in the same row.
